metadata.title: Cyclic $L_3$ Models and Holomorphic Reduction in Heterotic $G_2$ Deformation Theory
metadata.abstract: We construct a finite cyclic $L_3$ presentation (that is, a cyclic $L_\infty$ algebra with brackets vanishing above arity three) of the variational deformation theory defined by the heterotic $G_2$ superpotential near a torsion-free standard embedding, to first order in $\alpha'$. Auxiliary fields for the inverse coframe, spinor derivative, flux and induced tangent connection give a shifted-cotangent Hamiltonian of degree at most four. Eliminating the auxiliary fields recovers the physical functional. On the flat seven-torus, this functional has a nonzero quintic Taylor coefficient in local physical spinor coordinates. For $Y=S^1\times X$, with $X$ a Calabi--Yau threefold, we restrict to the product locus with horizontal gauge and gerbe data. The functional reduces to $ \frac L4\operatorname{Im}\int_X(H+i\,d\omega)\wedge\Omega, $ where $L$ is the circle length and $\Omega=e^{-2\Phi}\Psi$ is the weighted complex volume. The induced $SU(3)$ structure selects a Hermitian tangent Courant subalgebroid. Transverse isotropic lifts in its complexification encode the holomorphic connection and string equations, together with the induced tangent connection, weighted canonical line and gerbe hierarchy. Their Taylor brackets form an $L_3$ algebra whose string part agrees with the known holomorphic heterotic algebra. We then show that this holomorphic theory is obtained by characteristic Hamiltonian reduction of a finite contractible stabilization of the product variational theory, in every cochain degree. While the quotient captures the holomorphic equations, conformal balance, gauge primitivity and leading-flux admissibility are additional conditions on a real representative.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: heterotic G₂ 变形的有限 cyclic L₃ 模型
analysis.workSummary: 在无挠率标准嵌入附近、α′ 一阶构造有限 cyclic L₃ 变分模型，引入辅助场使 shifted-cotangent Hamiltonian 次数至多四，消元恢复物理泛函。对 S¹×Calabi–Yau 三折的 product locus，经有限可缩稳定化与特征 Hamiltonian reduction 得全 cochain degree 的全纯理论。
analysis.breakthrough: 用有限括号模型连接实变分理论与全纯 heterotic 变形。
analysis.limitations: L₃ 截断在扩展变量中成立，不意味着物理坐标泛函没有五次项；conformal balance 等仍是实代表的额外条件。
